description: The coins whose daily trend (regime) call changed, newest decision first: turned long (sent to Cryptohopper as a buy signal) or turned flat (a sell), decided at 00:05 UTC on the daily close, plus the next decision time, the coins whose live price is closest to the level that would change their call, how many Cryptohopper markets accepted each recent signal, and how many coins were long after each daily close over the last 90 days. A coin's starting call is not listed as a change. Give a coin for that coin alone: its current call, since when, whether it began as a change, and its calls over the last 90 closes.

coin.description: Only this coin, for example SOL: its current trend call and when it last changed
